dedupe_keys.name: cartographie des inondations du fleuve rhone digues hydrauliques

description: Cartographie des inondations du fleuve Rhône - digues hydrauliques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. As this data is an unvalidated work data, access is currently only possible to MEDDE services. The resource brings together the maps of flood envelopes of the Rhône for different Rhone flood scenarios developed to represent the evolution of these flood envelopes according to the intensity of these floods. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flood mapping of the Rhone River — hydraulic dikes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Grand public, RHONE ALPES, gestion de crise, Usage des sols, risque. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
